'
t Woudt
is a small village in the
Dutch
province of
South Holland
. It is located about 5 km southwest of the city of
Delft
, in the municipality of
Midden-Delfland
.
't Woudt (then spelled
"
't Woud") was a separate municipality between 1812 and 1817, when it was divided into
Groeneveld
,
Hoog en Woud Harnasch
, and a part that merged with
Hof van Delft
.
